variants.name: A · 鎏金纸契
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a high-resolution LANDSCAPE 16:9 comparison sheet of EXACTLY THREE fully visible vertical collectible game cards arranged side by side, same size, about 5:7 aspect ratio each, straight frontal view, generous gaps. Neutral muted plum presentation background. No battle screen, no characters outside cards, no hand fan, no extra miniature cards, no diagram arrows, no explanatory prose. This is an original card UI design exploration for a paper-theatre fantasy match-three card game. Use the supplied battle screenshot only as palette/world reference, do NOT reproduce the battle interface. Each card has beautiful distinct illustrated art, legible Chinese name near top, single type ribbon, readable short effect in lower panel.
CRITICAL FIXED COST RULE: The TOP LEFT corner of every card contains a VERTICAL COLUMN of elemental icons, aligned at the same X position and stacked downwards. EACH cost quantity is a large readable white numeral with a dark stroke placed DIRECTLY ON THE CENTER OF ITS ELEMENT SYMBOL, overlapping the symbol. Not beside, beneath, or in a separate attached bubble. The element symbol must remain recognizable around the numeral. No mana circles at top right; no horizontal costs. Reserve a left gutter to let this column grow to more attributes without covering title or effect text. Cost icons are cyan snowflake, orange-red flame, purple lightning; shapes plus colors distinguish costs. The title is to the right of cost gutter and cannot collide with it. Do not repeat costs anywhere else.
LEFT card: "碎晶弹", icy shard projectile art, type "攻击", effect "造成 7 点伤害。". ONE cost: blue snowflake with white numeral "1" centered OVER it at top-left.
MIDDLE card: "交错射击", two crossed elegant crystalline pistols with cyan and orange light trails, type "攻击", effect "造成 3 点伤害，获得 3 格挡。". TWO costs at top-left stacked vertically: cyan snowflake with numeral "2" directly OVER its center, and below it orange flame with numeral "1" OVER its center.
RIGHT card: "护身晶幕", faceted ice shield encircled by cyan crystal petals and purple magic ribbons, type "技能", effect "获得 5 格挡。". THREE costs in vertical column at top-left: snowflake with centered "2", flame below with centered "1", lightning below with centered "1". These are VISUAL COST EXAMPLES, not gameplay balance changes; do not add this explanation in the image.
Cards should be usable small in a game, prioritize cost and name over ornament. Painted illustration, crisp UI, high-quality paper / jewel textures, controlled light, no watermark or logos. Render all three cost configurations correctly: one/two/three. Keep number directly covering icon as absolute priority.
DESIGN A: rich classic paper-theatre card. Cream layered parchment frame, cut corners with modest antique gold fittings, plum inner bevel, slim burgundy name ticket, deep plum illustration window covering upper-middle half. Left fee gutter resembles a slim cream paper bookmark vertically attached at top-left; elemental symbols appear directly on it with numerals over them, NOT circular medallions. Lower text panel warm ivory parchment with clear dark-plum type. Subtle stitched gold perimeter and star embossing restrained to corners. Premium tactile paper and ornate but highly readable frame, reference palette.
